visual_cases.title: A reflection that seems wrong
observations: Three saved frames show a person beside a tall wall mirror in a domestic room, wearing a dark graphic sweatshirt and green-grey trousers.
The sampled poses move from facing one direction to a back-facing pose. The mirror appears inconsistent with an ordinary reflection across those samples.
The middle sample is washed out compared with the others. Caption and overlay supply a budget-mirror complaint premise.
visual_cases.interpretation: A reflection-mismatch effect is plausible. Exact editing method, timing and continuous synchronization were not verified. This is not a factual product-quality finding.

visual_cases.title: An oversized prop in an ordinary commute
observations: Three saved frames show seated people in a rail-car interior. One person holds a long tan scroll-like object; another looks at a phone.
The object is partly raised or rolled in the first sample and extends vertically through much of the later frames.
The central person wears a dark graphic top, dark shorts, light socks and light shoes. Overlay and saved caption connect the setup to a fantasy-game reference.
visual_cases.interpretation: The unusually large prop creates a contrast with everyday commuting. It may resemble a fantasy-game artifact, but the exact object, source scene, camera movement and dialogue remain unverified.

visual_cases.title: Wardrobe and prop as a character-reference cue
observations: The first saved frame shows a person in a dark knit cap, light long-sleeve top and muted trousers, holding a claw hammer indoors.
Two later samples are letterboxed footage in an outdoor wooded setting, with dark-clothed figures and motion blur.
The overlay and saved caption identify a television-character reference. A shift from a domestic portrait to different footage is visible, but cut timing and action details are not established.
visual_cases.interpretation: A wardrobe/prop resemblance appears to set up a character-reference edit. The inspected frames do not establish the full scene, stunt or any actual intent.
